Order 
This Criminal Original Petition has been filed to quash the proceedings in in S.T.C.No.373 of 2020 on the file of the Judicial Magistrate Court No.I, https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Coimbatore.

2. The case of the prosecution is that on 21.12.2018, the complainant gone to Suhani corporation at No. 354, Theppakula Veedi - 1, Coimbatore with an intention to take samples and at that time, the first accused was selling food items in his shop to the general public.

The complainant enquired about Processed Papaya Soaked in Sugar Syrup to the first accused and had taken samples of the said produce and sent the same to the food analyst on 21.12.2018 and the Analyst tested the product from 24.12.2018 ot 16.08.2019 and sent a report on 21.08.2019 stating that sample had added color exceed the defined limit is unsafe.
The designated officer sent a letter stating that the product had already lost its expiry.

The complainant had sought for permission to file case against the accused to S.Dipesh Bohra vs The Food Safety Officer on 19 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179998990/

Hence, the petitioner filed this petition to quash the said complaint.
3. Heard both sides and perused the materials available on record. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 4.
Considering the submissions made on either side, the fact the Food analyst given a report that the sample is unsafe.
It is a matter for trial and the petitioners can work out their remedy before the Trial Court.
Hence, I am not inclined to allow this petition.
However, the appearance of the petitioners before the learned Judicial Magistrate No.I, Coimbatore, is ordered to be dispensed with.
In the result, this petition is dismissed.
Crl.M.P.No.867 of 2023 is allowed.

Consequently,
Crl.M.P.No.866 of 2023 is closed.
